# Universal Races Compendium

Open `index.html` to use the compendium offline.

The book contains 22 creator-category sections in pantheon order. Every parent race appears inside its category, followed by its bloodlines, lineages, ancestries, or forms when applicable. Section 23 is the two-parent Heritage Generator.

## Contents

- 130 parent races
- 106 bloodlines, lineages, ancestries, and forms
- 22 creator categories
- Two-parent biological and assisted heritage generation
- Offline embedded race and genetics data

All filenames are Windows-safe. No installation or web server is required.
